summary: Backend + frontend testing for subscription/trial/paywall + gallery button. Backend: 22/22 pytest passing (15 original + 7 new subscription tests). Trial auto-provisioned on signup, /subscription/checkout returns 503 with placeholder Razorpay keys (expected), /food/analyze passes 200 during trial and correctly returns 402 'Subscription required' after trial expired via direct Mongo mutation. Webhook & callback reject invalid HMAC. Frontend: signup → onboarding → home shows 'Free trial · 10 days left' trial-banner; tap navigates to /subscribe which renders price-card (₹39/month, 10-day free trial), rzp-note ('Payment gateway not yet configured'), start-checkout-btn; clicking checkout correctly surfaces sub-error from 503. Profile → manage-subscription routes to /subscribe. /camera route renders; browser denies camera permission so pick-gallery-noperm shows (pick-gallery-btn exists in code next to shutter, only rendered when permission granted, per Expo). No blocking issues.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning in web console: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking but should migrate. Reference: multiple screens using shadow* props.
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted on onboarding & subscribe screens. Non-blocking but should be moved to StyleSheet.

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow (RN Web deprecation).
Optional: move pointerEvents from props to style.pointerEvents.
When real Razorpay keys are added, re-test POST /api/subscription/checkout should return 200 with subscription_id/key_id/amount_paise; frontend Continue with premium should open WebView checkout.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 573 lines — approaching split threshold; consider splitting into auth.py, subscription.py, food.py routers.
sub_public days_left uses (end-now).days + (1 if seconds>0 else 0) which correctly rounds up remaining fractional day; verified returns 10 immediately after trial start.
razorpay webhook idempotency via rzp_events insert with unique event_id relies on caller-supplied header — consider adding a unique index on event_id in Mongo to enforce.
require_active_subscription uses HTTP 402 which matches soft-paywall design and frontend can distinguish.
seed_data_creation: Created one fresh QA signup per pytest run (qa+sub_<ts>@example.com) and one UI signup (qa+ui<ts>@example.com); one subscription expired via direct Mongo update on the pytest QA user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are split into backend_test.py (core) and test_subscription.py (new). Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var when running pytest. Camera capture cannot be tested in browser (permission denied) — only assert /camera renders and either pick-gallery-btn (if perm) or pick-gallery-noperm (fallback) is present. Razorpay keys still placeholders — /subscription/checkout intentionally returns 503.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. Placeholder Razorpay behavior confirmed intentional (503 + 'not configured' message + rzp-note in UI).
